pixelReview.method: Directly inspected every caption crop sheet, every final composition sheet, and native mathematical/gameplay spot checks from the current burned-captioned video.
checks: All narration captions are fixed at1920x1080 center(960,970), opaque white with black text/border and forest shadow.
All cues have at most two lines and readable wrapping; no frame-edge clipping.
Full-screen existing-game action remains visible above captions. Source attribution stays above the caption reserve.
Mathematical diagrams, signs, angle units and declared coordinate conventions match the narrated explanations.
Original two-second cat logo and10-second membership image retain actual profile/name/badge identities and canonical coaching URL.
